rows.evidence: The faint, large, evenly outlined capitals reading '…NG EXTRA STRO…' sit behind the handwriting. They are a paper-manufacturer watermark, not ink, so they are not part of Grothendieck's text. Leaving them out, as both witnesses do, is correct.
